emailBatchStudents.subject: Important Update for You, {{fullName}}
emailBatchStudents.body1: We have an important update for you. Please check your dashboard for more details.
emailBatchStudents.body2: If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us.

welcomeEnrolledStudent.subject: Welcome {{fullName}}! Your enrollment is confirmed
welcomeEnrolledStudent.body1: Congratulations! Your enrollment has been confirmed. We're excited to have you with us.
welcomeEnrolledStudent.credentialsNote: Please change your password after first login.
welcomeEnrolledStudent.step1: Log in to your student dashboard with the credentials above
welcomeEnrolledStudent.body2: If you need help getting started, our team is here for you.

emailParentsBatch.subject: Update about {{fullName}}
emailParentsBatch.body1: We would like to inform you about an important update regarding your child {{fullName}}.
emailParentsBatch.body2: Please check the student portal for details or contact us if you have questions.

terminationNotice.subject: {{fullName}}, your membership has been updated
terminationNotice.body1: We're writing to let you know that your membership status has been updated. Your access has been removed from the organization.
terminationNotice.body2: If you believe this is an error or have questions, please contact the administrator.

audienceLeadConfirmation.subject: Thank you for your interest, {{parentName}}!
audienceLeadConfirmation.body1: Thank you for your interest! We've received your enquiry and our team will get back to you shortly.
audienceLeadConfirmation.body2: In the meantime, feel free to explore our website to learn more about our programs.

leadFollowupEmail.subject: {{parentName}}, following up on your enquiry
leadFollowupEmail.body1: We noticed you recently showed interest in our programs. We wanted to follow up and see if you have any questions.
leadFollowupEmail.body2: Our team is ready to help you with:
leadFollowupEmail.body3: Simply reply to this email or call us to get started!

paymentFailedEmail.subject: {{fullName}}, payment issue - action required
paymentFailedEmail.bannerBody: Your recent payment could not be processed.
paymentFailedEmail.body1: We were unable to process your payment. This may happen due to insufficient funds, card expiry, or a temporary bank issue.
paymentFailedEmail.step3: Try the payment again from your dashboard
paymentFailedEmail.body2: If the issue persists, please contact our support team.

abandonedCartReminder.subject: {{fullName}}, you're almost there! Complete your enrollment
abandonedCartReminder.body1: We noticed you started your enrollment but didn't complete the payment. Your spot is still available!
abandonedCartReminder.body2: Complete your enrollment now to secure your place and get started right away.
abandonedCartReminder.footNote: If you have questions about fees or need assistance, just reply to this email.

sessionStartReminder.subject: {{fullName}}, your live session is starting!
sessionStartReminder.body1: Your live session is starting. Join now to not miss anything!
sessionStartReminder.body2: Make sure you have a stable internet connection and your audio/video is working.

postSessionFollowup.subject: {{fullName}}, session complete - recording & next steps
postSessionFollowup.body1: Thank you for attending today's session! Here's a quick summary:
postSessionFollowup.item1: Session recording will be available in your dashboard
postSessionFollowup.item2: Review the materials shared during the session
postSessionFollowup.item3: Complete any assignments before the next session
postSessionFollowup.body2: We'd love to hear your feedback. Please take a moment to share your thoughts.

scheduledFeeReminder.subject: Fee payment reminder - {{dueDate}}
scheduledFeeReminder.body1: This is a reminder for the upcoming fee payment for {{studentName}}.
scheduledFeeReminder.body2: Please ensure the payment is made before the due date to avoid any late fees.

scheduledBatchReport.subject: {{fullName}}, your attendance report ({{startDate}} - {{endDate}})
scheduledBatchReport.heading: Attendance Report
scheduledBatchReport.intro: Hi {{fullName}}, here's your attendance summary for {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}:
scheduledBatchReport.body1: Regular attendance is the key to success.
scheduledBatchReport.concentrationScoreBody: = 80 pts attendance time + 20 pts interactions (chats, talks, raises, emojis, polls). View the full report for a per-session breakdown.

scheduledEngagementSummary.subject: {{fullName}}, your weekly engagement report
scheduledEngagementSummary.heading: Weekly Engagement Report
scheduledEngagementSummary.intro: Hi {{fullName}}, here's how you engaged this week:

scheduledParentsAttendance.subject: {{fullName}}'s weekly attendance update ({{startDate}} - {{endDate}})
scheduledParentsAttendance.heading: Weekly Attendance Update
scheduledParentsAttendance.intro: Here is the weekly attendance summary for {{fullName}} ({{startDate}} - {{endDate}}):
scheduledParentsAttendance.body1: If you have any concerns about attendance, please reach out to us.

membershipExpiryReminder.subject: {{fullName}}, your membership is expiring soon
membershipExpiryReminder.body1: Your membership is about to expire. Renew now to continue enjoying uninterrupted access to all your courses and materials.
membershipExpiryReminder.footNote: Don't lose your progress! Renewing takes just a minute.

scheduledExpiryCheck.subject: {{fullName}}, renew your membership
scheduledExpiryCheck.body1: Your membership will expire soon. Renew today to continue accessing your courses without interruption.
scheduledExpiryCheck.body2: Contact us if you have any questions about renewal options.

assessmentCreatedNotify.subject: {{fullName}}, new assessment available for you
assessmentCreatedNotify.body1: A new assessment has been published for you. Log in to your dashboard to view the details and start the assessment.

assessmentEmailBatch.subject: {{fullName}}, assessment submitted successfully
assessmentEmailBatch.body1: Your assessment has been submitted successfully. Results will be shared once the evaluation is complete.

inviteNotifyBatch.subject: New enrollment opportunity
inviteNotifyBatch.body1: A new enrollment invite has been created. Check your dashboard for details and enrollment instructions.

scheduledAudienceFollowup.subject: {{parentName}}, we haven't heard from you
scheduledAudienceFollowup.body1: We noticed you recently enquired about our programs. We wanted to check if you have any questions or need more information.
scheduledAudienceFollowup.body2: Our admissions team is happy to help with anything you need. Simply reply to this email!

liveSessionRecapPresent.subject: Thanks for attending {{sessionTitle}}
liveSessionRecapPresent.body1: Thanks for attending {{sessionTitle}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. We hope it was useful.
liveSessionRecapPresent.body2: Keep up the consistency — see you in the next class!

liveSessionRecapAbsent.subject: You missed {{sessionTitle}}
liveSessionRecapAbsent.body1: We noticed you weren't able to join {{sessionTitle}} on {{date}} at {{time}}.
liveSessionRecapAbsent.body2: No worries — please make sure to attend the next live class so you don't fall behind.

leadAssignedToCounselor.subject: New lead assigned: {{leadName}}
leadAssignedToCounselor.body1: A new lead has been assigned to you.

leadTatReminderBefore.subject: Reminder: respond to {{leadName}} within {{minutesToBreach}} minutes
leadTatReminderBefore.heading: Lead awaiting your response
leadTatReminderBefore.body1: This lead needs a response in {{minutesToBreach}} minutes:

leadTatOverdue.subject: Overdue: {{leadName}} has not been contacted
leadTatOverdue.heading: Lead TAT overdue
leadTatOverdue.body1: Hi {{counselorName}}, the SLA deadline has passed for this lead:
leadTatOverdue.body2: Please act on this lead as soon as possible.

followUpDue.subject: Follow-up due for {{leadName}}
followUpDue.heading: Follow-up due
followUpDue.body1: Hi {{counselorName}}, your next follow-up for {{leadName}} ({{leadMobile}}) is due in {{minutesToBreach}} minutes (at {{dueAt}}).

followUpOverdue.subject: Follow-up overdue for {{leadName}}
followUpOverdue.heading: Follow-up overdue
followUpOverdue.body1: Hi {{counselorName}}, the follow-up for {{leadName}} ({{leadMobile}}) is overdue (was due at {{dueAt}}).
